items.question: Which philosophical traditions and revered teachers are identified with the markless akulavīra?
premises: The subject is the same markless akulavīra named in the preceding verses.
Sāṃkhya and the Purāṇas are included among the identities of that akulavīra.
Arihant and Buddha are also explicitly included in this identification.
items.inference: The markless akulavīra encompasses not only major deities but also diverse philosophical traditions and revered teachers.
uncertainties: Whether sāṃkhyaḥ refers to the Sāṃkhya system, its founder, or its adherents is not specified.
The compound arihanta+buddha may reflect a dvandva pairing, but its precise internal relation is unstated.
items.plain_english: He is also Sāṃkhya, the Purāṇas, and indeed Arihant and Buddha.
